facts.fact: ASER's director-general told parliamentarians the rural electrification rate is 65.67%, with an estimated access level of 86%.
The Ministry of Energy, Petroleum and Mines states the rural electrification rate rose from 42.30% in 2018 to 65.84% in 2023.
UNESCO's readiness profile says that in 2018 only half of rural households had access to electricity, 52.5%.
